status: independent scene and pixel tests drafted; baseline awaits exact requester envelope and creative-control resolution
concept: The last graduate at the university gown-return desk after the ceremony

direction_comparison.selected: End-of-day robe return makes the transition visible through a still-worn robe, academic objects in the hands, an empty hanger and a rack of surrendered robes; a slight pause carries the feeling without invented biography.
direction_comparison.alternative_review: A posed graduation portrait gives strong symbols but loses the visible ending; a residence move-out scene has an intimate ending but needs more institutional clues to separate it from an ordinary bedroom. The selected desk scene keeps consequence and campus context together.

planned_relations: The main subject owns and wears the black academic gown, with shoulders and torso continuous.
One visible hand grips the mortarboard at waist height; the other holds a closed diploma cover against the gown.
A counter and empty hanger sit immediately beside the subject; returned matching gowns hang behind the counter.
University gown-return wording is visible within the same room, linking the gown, cap and diploma to a university ceremony.

gates.whole_gate: The main subject retains the reference short dark bob with wispy fringe and recognizably similar facial structure at usable face scale.
gates.unobservable_rule: A tiny, turned-away or obscured face cannot pass.

gates.whole_gate: University gown-return sign and academic return counter/rack are jointly visible, supporting university context rather than an unlocated costume portrait.
Academic gown on the main subject, square mortarboard and closed diploma cover are all recognizable together.
gates.unobservable_rule: A generic black garment or ambiguous rectangular object is partial.

gates.whole_gate: The still-robed subject with cap/diploma is spatially related to the return counter, empty hanger and returned gown rack in one frame.
gates.unobservable_rule: Disconnected background garments or an invisible hanger are partial.

gates.whole_gate: Both relevant hands belong to the main subject, cap/folder contact is coherent, and the standing body is plausibly supported.
gates.unobservable_rule: Hidden consequential hands or merged objects cannot pass.

decision_rule: Every consequential component and connection must be visible simultaneously; partial is not pass; missing pixels are unobservable; prompt audit and material exposure are separate evidence.
